verdict.rationale: Railway documents the Railway Agent, a chat-based AI assistant built into the dashboard. It can create and configure services, inspect deployments, diagnose failures, and open pull requests to fix code. It can also read from connected tools such as Notion, Linear, Sentry or custom MCP servers, and be invoked from Slack. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the built-in agent works as documented.
